evidence_scale.pinned-tree: File exists with the cited content at an immutable commit; not runtime proof.
evidence_scale.deterministic-test: Fixture or local check proves only the modeled behavior.
evidence_scale.hosted-observation: Observed GitHub/product state at a timestamp; can drift.
evidence_scale.official-doc: Current primary documentation; surface and maturity limits apply.
evidence_scale.official-source: Version-pinned implementation evidence; not a forward compatibility promise.
evidence_scale.source-open-work: Open source Issue or PR context; planned or unresolved work, never merged implementation proof.
evidence_scale.target-open-proof: Open target proof Task with durable observations but incomplete acceptance; not merged capability proof.
evidence_scale.target-open-work: Open target work order or artifact context; planned or unmerged and not implementation proof.
evidence_scale.target-proof-chain: Open target Epic/Task proof chain; durable control-plane context whose remaining gates are incomplete.

rolling_wave_rule: Rows needing later implementation point to the owning phase Epic until that phase is decomposed just in time. Existing runtime/acceptance Tasks are linked directly.
